Adaptation boundary:
Flash maps store line_left/right/bottom/player_bottom, p1/p2, floor children and
map/bg/front/front_fix positions in named MovieClips. configure() accepts those
values explicitly. A flattened existing Godot stage PNG contains no such metadata;
the integrator must supply its real width, bottom/player line, spawns and platforms.
No geometry is inferred from pixels and no new collision/floor rule is invented.
For a single baked stage image only the map layer is present. Foreground optical
alpha can only be used when props exist as independent drawable layers.
The source bounds convention is preserved even for nonzero bounds origins:
minimum = bounds.position * target_zoom; maximum = bounds.size - screen/zoom.
Regular follow/zoom is ported; Flash bitmap caching/logos, cinematic entry setup,
asset loaders, and original stage artwork are not copied by this module.
The adapter handles manual focus without Flash DisplayObject references. The caller
steps it once per upstream-equivalent logic tick; rendering shake stays external.

Verification: tests/bvn_map_port_test.gd (original work/test_bvn_map.gd), Godot 4.7.1 headless, 50/50 assertions passed.
Checks cover normalized spawn/floors/layers, strict platform edges, zoom limits,
easing and integer dimensions, inverse projection, movement clamp flags, source
bounds conventions, foreground order/parallax and two-tick optical transparency.
